# mangacn catalog

All 141 items in the registry. Each line gives the item's name, what it is, the one
command that installs it (with ink-frame first when it draws an outline) and its docs.
Swap `npx` for `pnpm dlx`, `yarn dlx` or `bunx --bun` to match the project, and keep the
flags: `--overwrite` answers the overwrite question for a file already there, and `--yes`
(on the theme's line) answers the theme's own prompt, so the command runs unattended
(see install.md).

A component page's Markdown (the `.md` URL) holds its props table and every demo's source:
read it, or the MCP's `get_item`, before using a prop.

## Foundation

The theme, its presets, its fonts, the pen and the motion presets. Install the theme once per
project; a preset (`theme-sepia`) brings the theme and gives it other paper, ink and spot.

- `theme`: Ink-on-paper tokens, screentone utilities and impact keyframes for manga-styled UIs.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/theme --yes --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming
- `theme-sepia`: An old tankōbon: warm aged cream paper, brown-black ink and a vermilion spot, with warm grey tones; dark is deep brown-black paper and cream ink.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/theme-sepia --yes --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming#presets
- `theme-weekly`: A weekly manga magazine: pale green-grey recycled newsprint, green-black ink and a magenta spot, with greys leaning green; dark is deep green-black paper and pale ink.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/theme-weekly --yes --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming#presets
- `theme-blueline`: A pencil draft before inking: cool white paper, blue-black ink and a deep blue spot (non-photo blue darkened to read as text), with cool grey tones; dark is deep blue-black paper, cool pale ink and the pale pencil blue as its spot.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/theme-blueline --yes --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming#presets
- `font-display`: Ultra-bold gothic display face for SFX and headings, exposed as --font-display.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/font-display --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming#fonts
- `font-dialogue`: Hand-drawn variable sans for speech bubbles and dialogue, exposed as --font-dialogue-latin.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/font-dialogue --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming#fonts
- `font-dialogue-ja`: Handwritten Japanese face the dialogue stack falls through to for kana and kanji, exposed as --font-dialogue-ja.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/font-dialogue-ja --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming#fonts
- `ink-frame`: Hand-drawn rough.js outline, fill and optional shadow behind any element; every outlined mangacn item uses it.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/ink-frame --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/theming#the-pen
- `manga-motion`: Spring and easing presets plus popIn, slamIn, shake and flash variants for motion.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/manga-motion --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/r/manga-motion.json

- `sidebar-15`: A notebook shell between two sidebars: on the left a studio switcher, main links, favourite notes, collapsible workspaces and help links; on the right the editor's account menu, a date picker and the studio's calendars; both put away with one shortcut, beside a note of blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-15 in ink.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/sidebar-15 --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/blocks/sidebar-15 (Markdown: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/blocks/sidebar-15.md)
- `sidebar-16`: An app shell under a sticky site header: the header's sidebar toggle, breadcrumb and search stay above a sidebar of collapsible sections, series with their menus, help links and the editor's account menu, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-16 in ink.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/sidebar-16 --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/blocks/sidebar-16 (Markdown: https://www.mangacn.com/docs/blocks/sidebar-16.md)

## Hooks

A hook installs with the item that needs it: that item declares it by URL, so its one add
writes the hook to the project's hooks folder (`hooks/<name>.ts`) and the item imports it from
`@/hooks/<name>`. A hook that needs a helper brings it as a lib file, where stock puts it
(`use-highlighted-code` writes `lib/highlighter.tsx` too). Add a hook alone only to call it
from your own components.

- `use-mobile`: Stock hook useIsMobile: true below 768 px, following the viewport; sidebar reads it to become a sheet on phones.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/use-mobile --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/r/use-mobile.json
- `use-highlighted-code`: Stock hook useHighlightedCode: shiki-highlighted lines that keep up with streaming code; ships lib/highlighter.tsx with it.
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @mangacn/use-highlighted-code --overwrite`
  Docs: https://www.mangacn.com/r/use-highlighted-code.json
